//: Invisible marker recording that this particular individual has already helped the player once.
//2: Attached to the monster rather than tracked in mod storage, so it is per-individual, survives saving, and cannot drift the way stored coordinates would.  Permanent by design: a second favour means finding a different person.
name: Already helped
desc: This person has already given you what they had.  If you see this on yourself, it is a bug.
